# Wheeloh

> Wheeloh is a free car spotting (carspotting) app for iPhone and Android. Photograph a car and
> Wheeloh identifies its make, model and version, scores the spot by performance, price and rarity,
> files it in a garage sorted by brand and pins it on a map. Spotters complete a collection of
> 1,154 models, climb world and friends rankings, find car meets, run car clubs, play "Guess the car"
> and share Instagram stories. Number plates are erased on the phone before a photo is uploaded.

Wheeloh is published by Wheeloh SAS (Versailles, France). Contact: contact@wheeloh.com.
The site exists in English (wheeloh.com) and French (wheeloh.com/fr); the app is in French and English.
Legal documents are in French.

## Key facts
- Price: free, no subscription and no paywall.
- Platforms: iPhone (iOS 16.6 or later) and Android.
- Availability: France, Belgium, Switzerland, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, the UK, the US, Canada and Australia.
- Car identification: AI recognition from one photo, matched against a database of more than 23,000 versions
  (about 1,680 models) from over 150 brands, model years 1904 to 2026. Wrong results can be contested in the app.
- Collection: 1,154 models from 74 brands and 14 countries; progress is drawn as a road with 30 milestones and 9 levels.
- Points: four layers (performance, excitement, price, rarity), from about 40 points for an everyday car to
  3,000 for an ultra-rare hypercar; +25% for visibly modified cars.
- Privacy: licence plates are detected and erased on the phone before upload; they can be masked by hand or shown.
- Gallery sync imports past car photos; screenshots and downloaded images are filtered out (anti-cheat).
- Latest version: 1.3.0 (October 2026), which added car clubs and a public feed.

## Guides and features (English)
- [Home](https://wheeloh.com/): the car spotting app, features and FAQ
- [Car spotting: the complete guide](https://wheeloh.com/car-spotting): what it is, where to spot, photo tips, etiquette and the law
- [Car identifier](https://wheeloh.com/car-identifier): identify a car from a photo
- [Licence plate blur](https://wheeloh.com/license-plate-blur): plates erased on the phone before upload
- [Car meets](https://wheeloh.com/car-meets): find, join and share car meets near you
- [Guess the car](https://wheeloh.com/guess-the-car): the five-try car photo game
- [Car clubs](https://wheeloh.com/car-clubs): communities with channels, meets, polls and news
- [Cars to spot](https://wheeloh.com/cars): the 1,154 models of the collection, with a page per brand
